message.content: {"caption":"Side-by-side iteration flows contrast a with/without-skill run with two with-skill runs for grid-dispatch-operator.","description":"A two-column flow diagram uses blue boxes for Arm A and red boxes for Arm B, with a downward arrow from Iter. 1 to Iter. 2 in each column.
